description: Find how long a shift or interval lasts between a start and an end written in military (24-hour) time, including shifts that run past midnight (2200 to 0630 is 8 hours 30 minutes). An end at or before the start counts as the next day. Returns hours and minutes and decimal hours for timesheets. Use military_time_convert to translate a single time between 24-hour and AM/PM, and time_duration_between when the two moments have different dates or a time zone with daylight saving.

end_military_time.description: The end in military time, for example 0630 or 06:30. At or before the start means the next day.

start_military_time.description: The start in military time, for example 2200 or 22:00.

name: military_shift_hours

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Hours between two military times
